summary: Preserve JSON.stringify space coercion, clamping/truncation, and indentation behavior.

target.notes: The Gap is derived once: Number/boxed Number is ToNumber then integer-clamped to 0..10 spaces; String/boxed String is truncated to at most 10 UTF-16 code units; other values produce no gap.

semantics.number_space: ToNumber/ToIntegerOrInfinity semantics then max 10 ASCII spaces
semantics.string_space: first at most 10 UTF-16 code units
semantics.format: when gap is non-empty, inserts line feeds and indentation exactly per JSON serialization algorithm

caveats: Substring by Unicode scalar value is incorrect; ECMAScript truncates strings by UTF-16 code units.

tests.name: numeric space clamped to ten
tests.expected_behavior: prints a three-line object with exactly 10 spaces before the member

tests.name: string space truncated to ten code units
tests.expected_behavior: indent prefix is abcdefghij, not all 11 characters
